title: Comparative Ct Method Quantification (2-ΔCt Method)
author: Barbara Rizzacasa
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zp7f5rn

steps.title: Obtain Ct values from curves
steps.instruction: For each sample run qPCR, generate an amplification curve, and record the threshold cycle (Ct), which is inversely proportional to the initial quantity of the target microRNA.

steps.title: Normalize to internal control (ΔCt)
steps.instruction: Subtract the Ct of the internal control from the Ct of the gene of interest for each sample to obtain ΔCt (ΔCt = Ct_gene‑of‑interest – Ct_internal‑control).

steps.title: Calculate 2^-ΔCt expression
steps.instruction: Calculate 2 to the power of negative ΔCt (2^‑ΔCt) to obtain the expression level of the microRNA in each sample.

steps.title: Compute ΔΔCt between samples
steps.instruction: For a test sample (A) and a control sample (B), compute ΔΔCt as ΔCt_A minus ΔCt_B (ΔΔCt = ΔCt_A – ΔCt_B).

steps.title: Calculate 2^-ΔΔCt relative expression
steps.instruction: Calculate 2 to the power of negative ΔΔCt (2^‑ΔΔCt) to obtain the relative microRNA expression of each sample compared with the control.
